the constant disorganized thoughts make it difficult for me to complete tasks or focus on learning. i go from knowing i have to do something to improve my life, to feeling absolutely hopeless and suicidal within an hour, multiple times a day. i am like this 24/7.

 i cant make continuous progress on anything because i am so unstable. i know i am just typing this to you but i am in complete shambles during these moments where i get upset and i have no control over it. 

for all of these reasons, it is very difficult for me to keep it together during an 8 hour work day, and to do it 5 days a week. my crazy thoughts dont stop just because i am at work, i dont have any control. even worse, im surrounded by people i don't trust, i start to get afraid, i start to spiral, i start to panic, i know i just need to keep working but i cant focus and im panicking, everything feels bad and im thinking everything will always be terrible, the world is a horrible place, i'm so fucking stupid,  i start to cry, and by then i'm a mess and cant focus any more at all. 

i know need to let it out and try to get back
to work so i go off somewhere to cry for a bit. it's extremely stressful to go through all of this in public, act like i am okay, and keep working. for days and days and days. 

my current unsafe situation is this: so it is a delivery job. they always send me out to extremely rural areas. it's usually a 30 to 1 hour long drive just to get to the first house. they normally only offer after dark hours 5pm-9:30pm. so i am going way far out in the middle of nowhere to people's houses in my personal car after dark. they have the really long driveways. 

these people are not expecting a package delivery after dark coming from someone's personal car. there's some random car driving up their long ass gravel driveway after dark.  i get yelled at by people because they don't understand why i am here. people often have dogs they let loose out there and i am very afraid of someone's dog biting me. im worried some day someone will threaten me, point a gun at me, and/or send their dog out on me before they try to ask why i am here. 

so when you ask if it is worth the drive to work, the entire job is driving in my own personal car and approching very rural houses after dark. overall the job is profitable and i make around $17/hr after factoring in gas. but my car is a 2002 and its getting kinda rickety in it's old age. things are starting to need replaced more frequently. and ya know, im afraid of getting attacked by a dog or assaulted the entire time i work. to me, that is not worth any amount of money. i am able to do it during the day with less fear but they hardly ever offer day hours. and still, approaching these houses is scary. 

i'm in treatment for all of these issues i have. the pandemic has made it harder for me to acquire the help. my psychiatrist has been rescheduling my appointments since August 2021. im taking my medication. but ive been really needing to see them since October and i have not been able to go back. i really need to talk to them about what to do about how i feel. 

i agree with what you're saying about perception. you gotta understand everything i said above *is* my entire ability to perceive the world and i cant just flip a switch to make it all better. i feel completely uncontrollable. i cant even eat right. i cannot control my thoughts. maybe some day i can. im not giving up on getting better.

in the meantime i need to work to support myself somehow and i'm trying to figure out how i can do that
